frequency_question: How often do motivated national principals successfully renew bilateral water treaties prior to expiration?
membership_rule: Includes formal transboundary water-sharing treaties between sovereign states that came up for renewal or renegotiation, where leaders publicly stated an intent to renew. Excludes unilateral abrogations or treaties without formal expiration dates.

cases.name: US-Canada Columbia River Treaty regime extensions
South Africa-Lesotho Highlands Water Project protocols
Senegal River Basin Development Organization (OMVS) charter renewals
Israel-Jordan water protocol extensions under 1994 Peace Treaty

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 named prominent bilateral water treaty renewals matching the structural criteria.
known_gaps: Does not account for minor bilateral streams where institutional neglect caused minor lapses.
skeleton: 6 historical renewals evaluated by principal motivation and capability within designated window
validity_reason: Bilateral hydro-diplomacy norms and state incentives regarding vital river basins remain stable through the decade.
